newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Stock turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE), the MSE said.
Total turnover fell to 199,341 denars from 266,409 denars at the last session on August 29 and traded volume dropped to 107 shares from 143.
Gradski Targovski Centar sold 107 stocks on the first floor at 1,863 denars, unchanged from last trading and below the par of 2,661 denars.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=39.46 denars; 1DEM=26.61 denars)
